teaser.text: Public Service Enterprise Group earns from regulated delivery networks, electricity generation, and operating services, with repairs and energy programs around them. To understand a dollar at PSEG, follow it from customers and wholesale buyers through wires, plants, contracts, workers, suppliers, financing, and regulated returns.

stock.title: PSEG stock forecast
stock.meta_description: PSEG’s weighted path reaches $73.35 by October 2029; bear and bull cases reach $48.82 and $101.18.
stock.opening: PSEG’s probability-weighted price is $73.35 by October 2029, a 17% gain including dividends. It hinges on rate recovery and financing staying manageable.
stock.closing: The full PSEG memo also answers how PSEG’s business, rivals, management and risks shape the forecast.

blocks.heading: Where could PSEG’s shares be by October 2029?

paragraphs.text: The forecast points to a restrained return from today’s $70.26 share price. The probability-weighted price is $66.70 by October 2027, a 1% loss including dividends. By October 2028, it reaches $69.82, a 7% gain including dividends. By October 2029, it reaches $73.35, a 17% gain including dividends.

blocks.heading: What has to go right or wrong for PSEG?

paragraphs.text: The bear case gives $2,050 million in 2027 and $2,040 million in 2028. It falls to $2,030 million in 2029 because delayed rate recovery, affordability pressure and financing costs offset progress. The bull case begins at $2,360 million, reaches $2,570 million, and ends at $2,800 million as faster recovery, strong nuclear output and contracted data-center or nuclear demand add earnings. Those opportunities remain uncertain. The model excludes volatile hedge, tax-credit, pension and nuclear-trust effects.

blocks.heading: How much cash does PSEG really make?

paragraphs.text: In 2025, operating cash flow was $3,298 million against net income of $2,111 million. Capital spending of $3,272 million then left free cash flow of only $26 million. Free cash flow is the cash remaining after operating needs and capital investment, so strong cash generation does not necessarily mean cash is available for dividends.

blocks.heading: What does an investor pay for PSEG today?

paragraphs.text: The forward P/E of 15.1x implies about $4.65 of earnings per share from the next twelve months. That is above the $4.28–$4.40 operating-earnings guidance for calendar 2026, partly because the forecast period extends into 2027. The lower multiple is therefore partly a promise of higher future earnings.

dividend.title: PSEG dividend: cash coverage and outlook
dividend.meta_description: PSEG pays a growing dividend, but free cash flow leaves little cash after investment, so funding and rate recovery matter.
dividend.opening: PSEG's indicative 2026 dividend is $2.68 per share, rising to $3.00 in 2029 in the base case. In 2025, free cash flow was $26 million, and dividends exceeded the cash left after investment, so borrowing and other funding supported shareholder payments.
dividend.closing: The full PSEG memo also covers its business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: How much does PSEG pay in dividends?

paragraphs.text: Dividends start from the indicative 2026 amount of $2.68 per share. The base case uses $2.78 in 2027, $2.89 in 2028 and $3.00 in 2029. That is slower than the recent 5% annual increases because investment has exceeded internally generated cash. The bear case holds dividends at $2.68 throughout. The bull case reaches $2.84, $3.01 and $3.19 as earnings and recovery support faster increases.

blocks.heading: Is PSEG's dividend covered by its cash?

paragraphs.text: In 2025, operating cash flow was $3,298 million against net income of $2,111 million. Capital spending of $3,272 million then left free cash flow of only $26 million. Free cash flow is the cash remaining after operating needs and capital investment, so strong cash generation does not necessarily mean cash is available for dividends.

Some capital spending preserves service, while some expands the future rate base, and the accounts do not cleanly separate the two. Dividends therefore exceeded the cash left after investment, so borrowing and other funding supported both construction and shareholder payments.

paragraphs.text: The bear case becomes more likely in 2027–2028 if rate-case timing or cost recovery disappoints. High customer bills from 2027 through 2029 would also pressure both earnings growth and the multiple.
Debt-funded spending is the key financing test in 2028–2029. If cash generation continues to lag capital spending and dividends, interest expense could rise and buybacks could weaken.

blocks.heading: What has PSEG guided for the year?

paragraphs.text: For 2026, management’s August 4 guidance is $4.28–$4.40 of non-GAAP operating earnings per share. Non-GAAP means PSEG removes selected volatile items from the standard accounting result, or GAAP profit, to show what it considers repeatable performance. Nuclear hedges can gain or lose value on paper as power prices move before electricity is sold, so statutory profit may differ from operating earnings.

blocks.heading: Has PSEG kept its past promises?

paragraphs.text: PSEG says 2025 was its twenty-first consecutive year meeting or exceeding operating-earnings guidance. Initial 2025 guidance was US$3.94–US$4.06 per share. The result was US$4.05. That supports confidence in forecasting, while safety, spending and succession still require scrutiny.

blocks.heading: What is PSEG's recent trend in revenue and profit?

paragraphs.text: Revenue fell 8.9% to $2,554 million from the year-earlier quarter. Net income fell 42.9% to $334 million. Yet adjusted earnings rose 10.7% to $425 million because both PSE&G and Power & Other improved.

Cash was less dramatic but still negative. June-quarter operating cash flow was $550 million, while capital spending was $766 million. Free cash flow was negative $216 million, improved from negative $309 million in the year-earlier quarter. First-half free cash flow reached $362 million, compared with $112 million a year earlier.

blocks.heading: What should I watch in PSEG's next results?

paragraphs.text: PSEG is scheduled to report third-quarter results on November 2, 2026. Management also expects a distribution base-rate filing by year-end 2026. Investors should watch investment execution and borrowing alongside any quarterly earnings beat.
